Municipal Reporting & Important Contacts

These are eThekwini Municipality reporting contacts. For official fault reporting, please use the appropriate municipal channel below. Reporting to Rowena on WhatsApp does not register a fault with the municipality.

Get in touch

Contact Rowena

Send your enquiry directly to Rowena on WhatsApp. Your message opens pre-filled in WhatsApp, and you choose whether to send it.

In immediate danger? Do not use this form. Call Metro Police, Disaster Management and Emergency Services on 031 361 0000.

Privacy: Nothing is stored on this website. What you type is passed to WhatsApp only, and nothing is sent until you press Send there. WhatsApp messages are not official municipal fault registrations.

Query category *
If you have already reported this to the municipality, enter the reference number you were given.
WhatsApp should now be open with your message ready. Please press Send in WhatsApp to complete your submission. If nothing opened, check that your browser allowed the pop-up.
